answer: Anyone running 26 aliases therefore needs 200 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in pearl, expire in harbor, and violet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 650 identities would post 2848 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
